decisions.reason: The DPA management software fits the firm's stated compliance and agency direction, has positive customer feedback, and as software costs little to keep running, so the option still holds value.
As the flagship platform shown on the home page in both years, it carries the firm's strategic direction and its value is still unfolding, so dropping it is very unlikely.
The configurable managed hosting plan sits close to the core offer, has kept its own page, and costs little to carry on shared infrastructure, so keeping it is cheap.

Extended PHP security support is new and only mentioned on the site, and it is tied to expiring PHP versions so it could be phased out, but it is cheap to offer and supports security positioning, so its uncertain value still justifies keeping it.
